def transform(grid):
    g = np.array(grid)
    H, W = g.shape
    bg = background(g)
    floor_row = H - 1
    out = np.full_like(g, bg)
    out[floor_row] = g[floor_row]
    emit(out, "Clear everything except the floor row at the bottom.")
    bars = [o for o in objects(g[:floor_row], bg=bg)]
    bars.sort(key=lambda o: -o["size"])
    y = floor_row - 1
    for o in bars:
        n = o["size"]
        out[y, W - n:W] = o["colour"]
        emit(out, f"Stack the length-{n} bar of colour {o['colour']} on row {y}, right-aligned.")
        y -= 1
    return out
